messages:
marta: kicking off transport for private/vpc release v1.12.0-private. target change window 09:00-11:00 UTC tomorrow. prepping split/shrinkwrap artifacts for airgap.
packaging-bot: artifacts generated: installer.tar.gz.{0..3}.sha256, installer.tar.gz.{0..3}.sig, manifest-v2.json (signed). uploaded to staging-mirror at s3://redwood-offline/staging/v1.12.0
ben: tagging images with digest pins. DO NOT use floating tags in the manifest. pinned runtime image to sha256:8f3a2c9b...
ingrid: confirming cosign signer is the HSM key (prod-signer-01). if cosign verification fails during transit, abort and rollback to 1.11.9.
samuel: plan for transport: rsync -> encrypted USB courier -> customer on-prem. escort will verify checksums + cosign sigs on arrival. ops-escort will sign receipt.
ops-escort: ack. escort checklist:
```
1) verify checksums: sha256sum -c checksums.txt
2) cosign verify --key k8s://projects/prod-signer-01 manifest-v2.json
3) check manifest image pins match local registry digests
4) validate installer unpack on staging node (dry-run)
```
marta: canaries: run installer dry-run on 3 seed nodes (a/b/c) after unpack. if any node fails grub mount or KMS handshake -> pause cutover and notify oncall.
ben: added fallback manifest manifest-v1.11.9.json to the transport bundle and included rollback script rollback-to-1.11.9.sh
samuel: transport ETA 2h after staging mirror sync. please confirm release notes update: SECURITY/packaging: switched to shrinkwrap split archives and signer rotation notes.
ingrid: release notes updated in docs repo, and binary checksums added. requesting approvals from security and compliance before final push :eyes:
packaging-bot: preflight checks: all slices present, cosign sigs attached, signer match OK, manifest pins present.
packaging-bot: checksum snapshot: installer.tar.gz.{0}: sha256:3a1f..., {1}: sha256:7b2e..., {2}: sha256:44ff..., {3}: sha256:12c9...
ben: remember to set deploy window in the console to prevent automated canary rollouts outside 09:00-11:00 UTC window.
marta: decision on image pin strategy: use immutable digest pins + allow fallback to smaller quantized variant only if checksum+cosign validated. note the quantized variant lives under registry.redwood.io/quantized/v1.12.0@sha256:aa11...
samuel: courier contact assigned. ops-escort will confirm arrival and run verification steps; if cosign verification fails, run `./rollback-to-1.11.9.sh --fast` and open incident.
ops-escort: will also run `tar -tzf installer.tar.gz` and run a quick unpack smoke. will report status here in thread.
marta: final ask -> product to confirm no last-minute schema changes that would break migration path. @ben @ingrid please confirm by EOD.
deploy-bot: transport job queued 4398765432-transport. status: queued -> started when mirror sync completes. will post incremental logs.
ben: approved. compliance gave thumbs-up earlier today. i'm on standby for a hot rollback if anything goes sideways. :thumbsup:
ingrid: security okayed signer rotation and packaging changes, noted in ticket #PRIV-452.
marta: thanks all. next update after mirror->courier handoff or earlier on any failure.
ops-escort: courier handed off. ETA to site 1h 20m. starting verification timer now.
packaging-bot: mirror sync complete, checksum files uploaded. deploy-bot: initiating transfer step.
deploy-bot: transfer started -> rsync -> /tmp/escort/installs/v1.12.0 . progress: 0% -> 100% (logs attached)
ops-escort: verification complete. cosign verify ok, checksums match, unpack smoke passed on seed node a. ready for dry-run canary.
marta: canary dry-run requested. run the dry-run on nodes a,b,c sequentially. if all good, we proceed to escorted handoff and signoff.
ben: dry-run results: a OK, b OK, c failed on post-install hook (permission denied on /var/lib/redwood). marking canary failed -> pausing rollout.
ingrid: noted. prepare rollback steps while we triage. can you paste the failing log snippet?
ben: log excerpt:
```
ERROR: /usr/local/bin/post_install.sh: line 42: cannot chown /var/lib/redwood: permission denied
```
samuel: likely caused by umask mismatch on node c. ops-escort, can you run `stat -c %a /var/lib` and `id` to confirm permissions?
ops-escort: ran checks. /var/lib was root:root 700. after we chown to redwood:redwood and rerun dry-run, installer proceeds. re-running dry-run on node c now.
ben: rerun shows all canaries OK. resuming escorted rollout.
marta: final signoff received from security/compliance/product. proceeding to delivery cutover in the window. deploy-bot will mark release pinned once final commit lands.
deploy-bot: release rollout complete. artifacts marked pinned: manifest-v2.json -> images pinned by digest. deploy-bot: closing transport job 4398765432.
marta: release closed. documenting postmortem actions: add preflight umask check to installer and a note in packaging checklist. thanks everyone. :tada:
